name: 损耗（控制/分析/改善）体系

map.损耗（控制/分析/改善）体系是做什么的？: What does Loss Control & Analysis System do?
map.如何使用损耗（控制/分析/改善）体系？: How do I use Loss Control & Analysis System?
map.损耗（控制/分析/改善）体系适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Loss Control & Analysis System best for?
map.📖 查看「损耗（控制/分析/改善）体系使用指南」: 📖 View the "Loss Control & Analysis System Guide"
map.按损耗量=应售量−实销量、损耗率=损耗量÷应售量×100% 的口径，分环节（进货: Using loss = expected sales − actual sales and loss rate = loss ÷ expected sales × 100%, it aggregates losses by stage (purchasing / shelf / stocktake / write-off) and locates the stages where losses concentrate; the result is a quantitative reference for store loss control, and improvement decisions should follow real operations.
map.每行输入「环节,损耗量,应售量」，如：进货,5,100: Enter one stage per line as "stage,loss,expected", e.g. purchasing,5,100
map.把各批次损耗数量贴入，统计损耗率与波动，识别损耗异常偏高的批次。: Paste the loss quantity of each batch to compute the loss rate and fluctuation and spot batches with abnormally high loss.
map.对比两个车间的损耗数据，用均值与: Compare the loss data of two workshops and use the mean and
map.判断哪个环节更不稳定。: to judge which stage is less stable.
map.汇总月度损耗，看趋势是收敛还是发散，评估改善措施是否见效。: Summarize the monthly loss to see whether the trend is converging or diverging and assess whether the improvement measures are working.
map.A 车间损耗 2.1 / 2.3 / 2.0 / 2.2（均值 2.15，标准差: Workshop A loss 2.1 / 2.3 / 2.0 / 2.2 (mean 2.15, standard deviation 0.11), Workshop B 1.5 / 3.8 / 1.2 / 3.1 (mean 2.4, standard deviation 1.05); the means are close but B fluctuates nearly 10 times more, showing unstable process control at B, so the improvement focus should be stability rather than merely lowering the mean.
map.损耗率怎么算？: How is the loss rate calculated?
map.页面统计的是你输入的数值本身；建议先把各项统一换算为损耗率（损耗量÷投入量）再贴: The page takes the numbers you enter at face value; it is better to convert each item to a loss rate (loss ÷ input) first and then paste them, for easier cross-comparison.
map.负数可能来自盘盈或录入错误；若为真实盘盈可保留，但需在备注中说明，避免误判为异常: A negative value may come from a stock surplus or an entry error; if it is a real surplus you may keep it, but note it in the remarks to avoid mistaking it for an anomaly.
map.多久复盘一次合适？: How often should a review be done?
map.建议按生产周期（周或月）固定窗口统计，窗口固定后数据才可跨期比较。: Use a fixed window per production cycle (weekly or monthly); only with a fixed window can data be compared across periods.
map.损耗（控制/分析/改善）体系：录入各环节损耗量与成因，量化损耗率、定位高发环节并: Loss Control & Analysis System: enter the loss quantity and cause of each stage to quantify the loss rate, locate high-loss stages and suggest improvement directions, for convenience-store and warehouse loss control.
